Global rating agencies have taken notice. The Japan Credit Rating Agency upgraded India to ‘A-’ for the first time in decades, and S&P raised the country to ‘BBB’ in August 2025. This year, both the World Bank’s flagship report and the IMF’s new research find that stronger fiscal and institutional credibility is associated with higher FDI.
